build_sam_vit_h: build a SAM model with ViT-Huge encoder architecture and optional pretrained checkpoint
build_sam_vit_l: build a SAM model with ViT-Large encoder architecture and optional pretrained checkpoint
build_sam_vit_b: build a SAM model with ViT-Base encoder architecture and optional pretrained checkpoint
build_sam: build a SAM model using the default ViT-Huge encoder with optional pretrained checkpoint
use_sam_model_registry: look up a SAM model builder function by name from the sam_model_registry dictionary
